messages:
emma-support: Hi team — escalating from a customer (ACME) who sees the Console show "eu-west-1" for their endpoint but their request logs/metrics show served_region=us-east-1. They're also seeing higher latency and unexpected egress charges. Ticket #5498 attached.

alex-customer: repro steps I ran: POST /v1/generate with API key, region header not present. Console shows region selector = eu-west-1. Request ID in response: req_0a1b2c3d. In serving logs I see: served_region=us-east-1 and latency ~320ms. Expected EU serving ~80ms.

emma-support: Screenshot they sent: console top-right badge "Region: eu-west-1 (Pinned)" and in activity feed the request shows as completed. They copied the raw request/response — response meta includes: `{"request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d","served_region":"us-east-1","model_variant":"redwood-1.2-quant"}`

jason-eng-runtime: Thanks, tagging eng-sre @priya-eng-sre. Quick Q: was this during a known failover window? Any autoscaling events in eu-west?

priya-eng-sre: No active region outage in eu-west for that timeframe. I see normal capacity. Can you paste the request headers (no secrets) and the console session id? Also did the customer have a routing policy (geo, cost-tier) configured?

emma-support: Pasted headers (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]
User-Agent: acme-integration/1.4
X-Request-Id: req_0a1b2c3d
X-Client-Region: eu-west-1
```
Console session id: csess_78f9. They say they didn't configure any routing policy beyond default.

priya-eng-sre: I pulled routing logs for req_0a1b2c3d: router showed a policy eval -> preferred_region=eu-west-1 but fallback_candidates included us-east-1 with ping-based weight. The router selected us-east-1 due to node-level capacity token shortage in eu-west at the instant (short transient). That would explain served_region.

jason-eng-runtime: Why is the Console badge showing eu-west pinned? Is that from the customer's profile or the control plane cached mapping?

leah-eng-platform: Console displays the selected preferred_region from the control plane config (what the customer last clicked). It doesn't update on per-request fallback decisions. We rely on runtime logs/metrics for actual served_region. Console should probably surface "last served region" per-request in the activity feed — looks like that's missing or out of sync for this payload. 

emma-support: Customer is upset because billing showed cross-region egress and they had compliance requirements. They want a rollback of charges or a credits investigation.

priya-eng-sre: For immediate mitigation: 1) we can pin their routing policy to strict eu-west (no fallback) for a short window — will cause 429s if capacity exhausted but avoids cross-region serving. 2) Or we can enable a soft-preference with higher weight to eu-west. Which does support recommend?

emma-support: Customer asked for strict pinning. Please do the pin and note impact. Also advise if there was any billing guardrail that should have blocked cross-region egress for org-level compliance.

jason-eng-runtime: I applied a strict routing override to the customer's org (org_acme) at 1784123530 — pinned to eu-west-1. Confirmed via control-plane audit: `PATCH /v1/orgs/org_acme/routing {"preferred_region":"eu-west-1","allow_fallback":false}`. Adding an alert to watch for 429s.

deploy-bot: audit-log: routing.override.created org=org_acme actor=jason-eng-runtime id=ovr_9c7a timestamp=1784123530

priya-eng-sre: Follow-ups: 1) we should add a Console indicator when a per-request fallback occurred (so customers don't assume console badge == served). 2) Add a billing guardrail feature flag for strict-org-region to block cross-region serving when enabled. I'll file infra tickets.

leah-eng-platform: Filed FE ticket FE-1287 to show per-request served_region and a warning banner when fallbacks occur.

emma-support: Customer notified and grateful for pin. They asked for a short write-up of root cause and remediation for their compliance review — can one of you produce a brief note they can include?

jason-eng-runtime: I'll draft a 3-line root cause: transient capacity shortage in eu-west triggered runtime fallback to us-east for a small subset of requests; Console reflects configured preferred_region (control-plane) and doesn't show per-request fallback. Remediation: routing pin applied; Platform tickets created for UI surface and billing guardrail.

emma-support: Perfect — passing to customer. Closing internal thread unless others want to add. :white_check_mark:
